identity.name: Journal of Orthopaedic Trauma
identity.source_note: The Wolters Kluwer/LWW 'Information for Authors' page (journals.lww.com/jorthotrauma) is a pointer that only links to the detailed instructions on the Editorial Manager site; it also redirects automated fetches to the journal home page. guidelines_url is that authoritative detailed instructions page (edmgr.ovid.com/jot/accounts/ifauth.htm), which curl fetches cleanly as full server-rendered HTML, so source_hash is of the real normalized guide text (83,551 chars, reproducible).

encoding_notes: Rules encoded from the authoritative JOT 'Instructions for Authors' hosted on Editorial Manager (edmgr.ovid.com/jot/accounts/ifauth.htm), which the LWW/Wolters Kluwer Information-for-Authors page points to. curl fetched full server-rendered HTML, so source_hash is of the real guide text (reproducible).

Peer review is double-blind: a separate unblinded title page + de-identified manuscript body (no author initials, institution or hospital-unit names in text, tables, or figures; 'we'/'our' discouraged). scrub_metadata set true as an inference required for effective double-blind review (not stated verbatim).

article_types mapping onto the enum: 'Clinical Investigation' (350-word structured abstract, 3500-word body) -> original_research (primary); 'Basic Science' (300-word structured abstract, 3500-word body) and 'Survey' (300-word structured abstract, 2500-word body) also fold into original_research; 'Systematic Reviews/Meta-analysis' (300/3500) -> systematic_review; 'Technical Tricks and Potential Pitfalls' (unstructured 300-word abstract, 2500-word body) -> technical_note; 'Letters to the Editor' (300 words) -> letter. No standalone Case Report type is offered.

word_limits.original_research uses the Clinical Investigation caps (body 3500, abstract 350). Basic Science and Survey have a 300-word abstract and Survey a 2500-word body — noted here since they share the original_research enum key. Reference/figure/table caps are not numerically specified in the guide -> null.

abstract.sections reflect the structured clinical-investigation abstract (Objectives/Methods/Results/Conclusions). A Level of Evidence assignment is separately required for clinical studies (tracked out-of-schema). technical_note uses an unstructured abstract. Keywords: three to five required.

sections encoded only for original_research and systematic_review (Introduction/Methods/Results/Discussion/Conclusions), which the guide defines; technical_note and letter body structures are not encoded to avoid guessing.

layout: guide explicitly requires 8.5x11 (letter) page, >=1-inch (25.4 mm) margins on all sides, double spacing, and continuous line numbers. Font (Times New Roman 12) is a placeholder default — NOT specified by the guide; alignment, first-line indent, page numbers, and running head are unspecified and defaulted to null/false for the engine to flag.

references: journal follows the AMA Manual of Style; numbered consecutively in citation order; name the first three authors then 'et al' when >3 (et_al_threshold 3); journal names abbreviated per PubMed/Index Medicus (mapped to 'nlm'). in_text 'superscript' inferred from AMA style (not stated verbatim). include_doi false: DOIs required only for online-only/web references, not standard journal citations.

figures: acceptable file types tif/jpg/eps/pdf; separate file per figure; photographs/scanned images >=300 dpi and line art >=1200 dpi (min_dpi encodes the 300 halftone minimum). Figure legends placed at the end of the manuscript body after references (figure_legends_section); callouts use 'Figure'. Tables numbered consecutively in arabic (roman numerals prohibited), descriptive title above; placement 'grouped_end' inferred (guide does not state placement explicitly).

declarations: authors must disclose conflicts of interest and funding (in three locations incl. the title page); informed consent and patient anonymity are required (patient_consent). IRB/ethics approval is required for human studies except retrospective/cadaver (ethics_approval listed in order, conditional). misc: ORCID and a submission cover letter are not required by the guide -> false; title case not specified -> null.

Session-A consolidation (2026-07-09): supersedes any earlier note in this list that describes source_hash as a bot-challenge 'shell' hash or that records a placeholder body font/line-spacing. Authoritative current state: source_hash is reproducible per identity.source_note; font family/size and line-spacing are null wherever the live guide is silent, so the engine preserves the author's value rather than imposing a guess.
